_about: Public-domain I. A. Dorner (1809-1884, Lutheran, professor at Berlin) in pre-1930 English translations from T. & T. Clark, raw Internet Archive OCR: A System of Christian Doctrine (4 vols, tr. Alfred Cave and J. S. Banks, 1883-88, a mixed printing), History of the Development of the Doctrine of the Person of Christ (5 vols, tr. W. L. Alexander and D. W. Simon, 1889-92), History of Protestant Theology (2 vols, tr. George Robson and Sophia Taylor, 1871) and System of Christian Ethics (tr. C. M. Mead and R. T. Cunningham, 1887). Several title pages garble his name; each was read. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 16 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
